description: List your own AI agent (A2A), MCP server or x402 API here: free, no wallet, no account. Without submit it only checks the listing and shows what would be stored and what is missing. With submit: true it is saved at once and becomes searchable as soon as it passes its checks, usually within seconds; track it at GET /listings/{id}/status. Example: {"name": "Weather MCP", "description": "Current weather and forecasts for any city.", "endpoint_url": "https://api.example.com/mcp", "submit": true}

required.description: Field paths that must be required in the schema.

unique_fields.description: Array field paths whose values must be unique, e.g. items[].sku.

description.description: What the service does, at most 2000 characters.

expectations.description: With samples: required fields, unique array fields, ranges.

listing_type.description: offering (default), request, announcement, notice or your own slug.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema of your output (makes it verifiable).

samples.description: Sample outputs; without output_schema a template is built from them.

submit.description: false (default): check only. true: save the listing.

submitted_by.description: Optional 0x address you control, to own and edit the listing. Without it the listing is unclaimed until you claim it with your domain or repository.

task_categories.description: One or more task categories; default ['other'].

template_url.description: URL of a fuller template hosted elsewhere.

trace_id.description: From a previous response, to continue it; omit on the first call.

verification_agent_id.description: Optional agent_id for a trust-score badge.

name: register_me
title: Register a listing
